# `cts_search_transports`

Search transport requests via /sap/bc/adt/cts/transports?_action=FIND. Filters: user (owner), trfunction (K/W/T/*), status (D/R/L/... client-side filter).

Defined in [`packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/cts-search-transports.ts`](https://github.com/abapify/adt-cli/blob/main/packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/cts-search-transports.ts).

## Input schema

| Parameter     | Type     | Required         | Description                                                                                                       |
| ------------- | -------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baseUrl`     | `string` | no               | SAP system base URL (e.g. https://host:8000) Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                                             |
| `client`      | `string` | no               | SAP client number Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                                                                        |
| `username`    | `string` | no               | Username for basic auth Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                                                                  |
| `password`    | `string` | no               | Password for basic auth Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                                                                  |
| `systemId`    | `string` | no               | Logical system id (resolved via the server multi-system configuration) Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                   |
| `user`        | `string` | no               | Owner filter – username or * for all (default: *) Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                                        |
| `trfunction`  | `string` | no               | Transport function filter – K=workbench, W=customizing, T=copies, * for all (default: *) Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞. |
| `status`      | `string` | no               | Optional client-side filter on TRSTATUS (e.g. D=Modifiable, R=Released) Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                  |
| `maxResults`  | `number` | no               | Maximum number of results (default: 50) Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                                                  |
| `destination` | `string` | destination mode | Required when the server runs in destination mode; an ADT destination key matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]\{1,62\}$`.    |

_In destination mode every call additionally requires a `destination` key and rejects the connection fields (`baseUrl`, `client`, `username`, `password`, `systemId`)._

## Output

The tool returns a single text content item whose body is a JSON-serialised object (`content[0].text`). On error, the response has `isError: true` and a human-readable message.

```json
{
  "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "<JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)>" }]
}
```

See the source for the exact shape of `result`.

## Example invocation

```json
{
  "name": "cts_search_transports",
  "arguments": {
    "baseUrl": "https://sap.example.com:44300",
    "username": "DEVELOPER",
    "password": "***",
    "client": "100"
  }
}
```

## Underlying contract

- `client.adt.cts.transports.find`
